problem_text:
A manufacturing enterprise aims to devise a resource conservation strategy to curtail total raw material waste from several production lines. Initially, no efficiency improvements have been implemented.

The characteristics of each production line are as follows:
* For Line 1, the waste coefficient is 1.217, and the output volume is 51.313.
* For Line 2, the waste coefficient is 2.574, and the output volume is 69.806.
* For Line 3, the waste coefficient is 2.24, and the output volume is 113.981.
* For Line 4, the waste coefficient is 0.847, and the output volume is 258.741.
* For Line 5, the waste coefficient is 2.264, and the output volume is 187.201.
* For Line 6, the waste coefficient is 1.622, and the output volume is 231.809.

To mitigate waste, several efficiency enhancement techniques are available, each characterized by a specific material savings rate:
* By deploying Technique 1, material waste will be lowered by 48%
* By deploying Technique 2, material waste will be lowered by 81%
* By deploying Technique 3, material waste will be lowered by 67%
* By deploying Technique 4, material waste will be lowered by 66%
* By deploying Technique 5, material waste will be lowered by 86%
* By deploying Technique 6, material waste will be lowered by 56%

Implementing a technique on a production line incurs an additional cost per unit of output. The cost matrix for all line–technique pairings is provided below:

| Line \ Technique | Technique 1 | Technique 2 | Technique 3 | Technique 4 | Technique 5 | Technique 6 |
|--|-|-|-|-|-|
| Line 1 | 160.841 | 96.852 | 31.063 | 181.978 | 123.38 | 13.123 |
| Line 2 | 107.921 | 55.968 | 37.28 | 91.555 | 126.814 | 55.707 |
| Line 3 | 89.148 | 136.231 | 26.267 | 195.184 | 22.859 | 109.951 |
| Line 4 | 106.392 | 197.783 | 115.289 | 84.186 | 99.326 | 130.777 |
| Line 5 | 196.397 | 58.194 | 13.086 | 159.819 | 75.512 | 149.259 |
| Line 6 | 129.369 | 156.585 | 149.686 | 73.179 | 18.424 | 113.743 |

The firm must decide how to apply these techniques to each line (lines may adopt multiple techniques concurrently), and a line may also operate with partial improvements if required. The objective is to guarantee that the total raw material waste is reduced by at least a fraction T = 0.522 of the baseline amount W0, while minimizing the aggregate implementation cost.
